package.name: sentry_scan_adapter_cpp
package.description: C++ runtime adapter for the RM -> SCAN-Planner shadow/takeover path: reads real odom/velocity/cloud, publishes body_pose/sensor_pose/cloud in the planning frame, and provides the command gate (default-disabled) that is the only SCAN-side publisher allowed to reach the chassis topic. Shadow-only tooling stays in the Python package.
